messages:
anya: hey — noticed the cost heatmap shows weird spikes for tenant `acme-inc` after we enabled sampled prefetch credits. looks like a sample-rate mismatch between telemetry and billing. anyone seen this?
devon: yup, saw alerts. the per-token unit we show in the dashboard is raw_observed_cost, but billing uses sampled->extrapolated numbers. prefetch credits get under/over-attributed when sample_rate != 1.
marco: can we expose an "effective_token_cost" on the console that normalizes by sample_rate? UX would match what finance expects if we do `cost / sample_rate`.
anya: prototyped a quick patch that normalizes at ingest and adds a `sampled_normalized` field on unit_econ. breaks the sparkline aggregation though since prefetch credits are bucketed by slab window. preview at <https://redwood-console/proto/cost/preview?slice=sampled>
devon: important constraint: the backend chargeback ledger is immutable for the billing window. we can't change ledger semantics without legal/finance signoff. so this has to be console/telemetry-only unless we do a reconciliation job.
marco: agreed. propose two layers: (1) console-only metric `effective_cost` for UX/what-if; (2) normalized telemetry path for alerts/SLOs (where reconsent is less sensitive). ledger stays untouched. add a rollout toggle for safety.
anya: sketch UX: heatmap header gets a toggle "Normalize for sampling" (off by default). tooltip: "Adjusts token cost for sampling so prefetched credits line up with observed burn. preview-only." quick impl: `effective_cost = raw_cost / max(sample_rate, 1e-6)`
devon: edgecases: sample_rate is per-route and per-sku; if sample_count is low dividing will explode variance. we should only show normalized view when `sample_count >= 100` or show a CI band.
marco: +1 to cutoff. also add a small badge on the heatmap hover: "sampled view" linking to raw numbers. can we gate behind a canary flag so we don't spook finance?
ops-bot: ops-bot: feature-flag `console.normalize_sample_rate` created. canary group = 10% users, rollout steps: 1h -> 6h -> 24h. created ticket INF-1298 /flag
anya: i'll open a PR for console + telemetry changes and include unit tests for the sample_count cutoff and aggregation windows. @marco @devon want to review? i'll attach before/after screenshots.
marco: :thumbsup: i'll take the first pass tonight. one more UX ask — add a "cost lens" link from the token detail modal to the model page explaining sample normalization and when to trust preview.
devon: and please add a clear note in /docs/console/costs: "preview metrics are scaled for UX and do not affect invoices" — finance will want that spelled out :)
